_comment: Spec files under tests/e2e/ that the post-deploy production run does NOT invoke.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (2026-09-02). post-deploy-e2e.yml selects its specs by
NAME. On the day this was written, 19 of the 34 spec files at the top level of
tests/e2e were not named anywhere in it, so they had never run against
production even once - and nothing said so. The workflow's own comment warns
about exactly this shape ('nine route suites stayed invisible one level down'),
and the fix applied there was to pass a DIRECTORY. The top level kept its
hand-written list, so the hole reopened one file at a time.
Four of the nineteen were regression nets Dan asked for BY NAME after a live
complaint - seat-first-entry ('I STILL CAN'T EVEN SIT DOWN AND PLAY'),
live-animations ('now do a real live e2e browser test of everything'),
hero-cards-no-glitch (bug list item 4) and multi-table (the PokerBros-parity
net). They were written, merged, and then never run after a deploy.
THIS IS A RATCHET, NOT AN ESCAPE HATCH - the same rule as
e2e-may-skip-entirely.json next to it. A file listed here is a standing
admission that production is not covered by it. The number goes DOWN.
tests/unit/everyProductionSpecIsWiredOrDeclared.test.ts fails the build when a
spec is neither invoked by the workflow nor listed here, so a twentieth file
cannot be added beside these and quietly never run.
Paths are relative to tests/e2e, exactly as they appear on disk.
